newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates stocks mixed in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates stocks mixed in subdued trade.

text.p: Shares on the United Arab Emirates informal stock market were mixed in the week to Thursday, but trading was thin and mostly limited to low-priced shares, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week at 2,334.85 points from 2,332.02 points last week.
National Dredging Co and Abu Dhabi National Hotels Co each lost five dirhams to 400 and 1,000 dirhams respectively. Union National Bank and NABD shares gained 10 dirhams each to 290 and 410 dirhams.
Dubai Islamic Bank lost two dirhams to close at 168 dirhams.
Brokers said Dubai Investment Co shares were traded in small quantities at between 13.25 and 13.50 dirhams. Market leader Etisalat was dealt at 930 to 933 dirhams.
